job: Write one already-resolved tree into product source inside a frozen owner ceiling and a declared file set, emitting only values the bound resolution receipt already contains.
sideEffects: write the files declared in input.writeSet, each under a mutable owner root
write only the typed application receipt under input.project.artifactRootRef
forbiddenSideEffects: write a class, value, or rule identifier absent from the bound resolution receipt
decide a presentation value, choose a Grammar component, or restructure the tree
touch a file outside the declared write set
touch a file under an observation-only owner
edit knowledge, publish Grammar, or change the resolution receipt
start, stop, or reconfigure runtime services
record a verdict, score, or pass claim on the applied source
stopConditions: the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a file that must change lies outside the declared write set
a declared write set path lies outside every mutable owner root
the bound resolution fingerprint differs from the one actually read
the resolution does not contain a class the write would produce
no declared path produces an effective content change
a resume adds no effective resolution, write set, or scope delta
